overview_description.description:
Machine Zone develops mobile games in various genres that include fantasy/RPG/MMO. It offers its games for Android. iPad, iPhone, and iPod Touch platforms. 

Gabriel Leydon, Halbert Nakagawa, and Michael Sherrill founded Addmired in 2008 that became Machine Zone in March 2012. Its headquarters is in Sunnyvale in California.
